description: Every update gets GitHub's auto-merge and is merged once a code owner in .github/CODEOWNERS approves it and the pull request's checks pass, and the weekly release picks up what was merged as a patch release. gomodTidy runs go mod tidy after every Go update, and gomodUpdateImportPaths lets a major Go module update rewrite the import paths; without it Renovate skips go mod tidy on major updates and leaves go.mod untidy

packageRules.description: A new Go minor in the go directive raises the Go every user of go install needs, and CI follows it through go-version-file. It waits for approval on the dashboard; patches flow as usual
